dedupeText: southern rock surrealism album art 1970s rock aesthetic surrealist illustration reel to reel tape electric guitar fire bubble lettering analog recording gear the reel to reel head acts as the primary focal point replacing human features the red tape creates a horizontal movement that connects the central figure to the edges of the composition the flames at the bottom provide a warm energetic foundation for the cooler mechanical elements above combine surreal object head figure with chaotic tangled element and elemental base fire water using 1970s airbrush illustration style and volumetric bubble typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist 1970s airbrushed illustration featuring a humanoid figure with a reel-to-reel tape machine for a head, playing a gold-top electric guitar. The figure is entangled in chaotic red magnetic tape that spills across the frame, emerging from a base of stylized orange and yellow flames against a neutral off-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: The reel-to-reel head acts as the primary focal point, replacing human features.
The red tape creates a horizontal movement that connects the central figure to the edges of the composition.
The flames at the bottom provide a warm, energetic foundation for the cooler mechanical elements above.
coreInvariants: Gold-top electric guitar held in a playing position

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, medium-shot framing of the figure from the waist up, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The two white tape reels forming 'eyes' for the machine head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large bubble text at the top, moves down to the tape machine head, follows the guitar neck diagonally, and settles on the script text within the flames.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white space in the upper corners and sides to allow the complex central illustration to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background providing a clean, vintage canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red of the magnetic tape and the warm oranges/yellows of the fire.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and metallic silver on the guitar and tape machine components.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and oranges against a desaturated, neutral background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif and casual script.
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thick, rounded bubble letters with internal airbrushed gradients and highlights to simulate 3D volume.
Bottom text: Fluid, connected script with a consistent slant and uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top title feature 'cut-out' or stencil-like gaps in the strokes.
Bottom script is integrated into horizontal parallel lines representing a staff or tape path.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of heavy, volumetric geometric display type with light, linear script.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar energy for the bottom script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: An airbrushed illustration of a man with a vintage reel-to-reel tape player head, wearing a dark jacket, playing a gold electric guitar. Red magnetic tape is tangled around him and flying out to the sides. The bottom of the figure is engulfed in stylized orange flames. Background is plain off-white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, 3D airbrushed bubble letters at the top in an orange-to-yellow gradient. Add a single line of dark red script at the bottom, centered within three horizontal parallel lines that cross through the flames.

verificationChecks: Is the tape machine head clearly visible?
Does the red tape create a sense of chaos?
Is the top text volumetric and airbrushed?
Are the flames at the bottom stylized rather than photorealistic?

adjustableVariables: Gradient colors in the top text
mustRedesign: Confederate flag imagery on the guitar headstock
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the guitar neck is held at a natural playing angle.
Check that the red tape flows behind and in front of the figure.
Verify the 3D effect on the top lettering is consistent with the lighting.
Confirm the script text is legible against the fire background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Object-Head Figure] with [Chaotic Tangled Element] and [Elemental Base: Fire/Water] using [1970s Airbrush Illustration Style] and [Volumetric Bubble Typography].
